notice: FICTIONAL DEMO DATA. Derived from the fictional requests in requests.json.
method: Requests grouped by meaning (not keywords) by an LLM, using the prompt in PROMPT.md.

scoring.totalBookings: Sum of operatorSize (bookings per month) over the distinct operators asking; an operator is counted once per theme.

themes.name: Guide payouts
themes.problem: Operators can't see what each guide is owed for a period, so they rebuild payouts in spreadsheets every month.

pain.reason: It costs owners days of manual work every month and causes disagreements with freelance guides over pay.

effort.reason: Tours and staff assignments already exist; the work is rate rules (per tour, per guest, hourly), tips and a per-guide summary.

themes.name: Bokun sync reliability
themes.problem: Bookings and availability from Bokun arrive late, duplicated or out of date, causing overbookings and manual clean-up.

pain.reason: It directly causes overbooked tours, refunds and wrong headcounts at the meeting point.

effort.reason: Fixing it needs idempotent webhook handling, near-real-time availability sync and automatic product updates against a third-party API.

override.reason: Overbookings, refunds and duplicate bookings hurt the operators' own guests and cost them money right now. The score ranks it #2 only because effort is L – it doesn't capture that kind of risk.

themes.firstStep: Quick fix this week: stop duplicate bookings from re-delivered Bokun webhooks (REQ-021). Then the full sync work.

themes.name: VAT invoices
themes.problem: Invoices can't include the client's company details or per-line VAT rates, so operators recreate them by hand.

pain.reason: Operators have a manual workaround, but it is slow and accountants reject non-compliant invoices.

effort.reason: Needs company/VAT ID fields at checkout and per-line VAT rates on the invoice, with rules differing by country.

themes.name: Pickup times
themes.problem: Guests and drivers don't get clear per-hotel pickup times, and changing them for a departure is manual.

pain.reason: It creates a steady stream of guest questions and driver confusion, but rarely loses a booking.

effort.reason: Requires pickup points with times per departure, bulk time changes with notifications and a printable list per vehicle.

themes.name: Group bookings
themes.problem: Large groups and agency allotments must be entered as many single bookings with manual discounts.

pain.reason: Headcount changes and forgotten discounts are tedious and error-prone, though operators can cope manually.

effort.reason: It changes the booking model: one booking for many seats, held allotments with automatic release and group pricing rules.

themes.name: Waitlist
themes.problem: Customers can't join a waiting list for sold-out departures, so operators track interest by email.

pain.reason: It is missed upsell and some inbox work rather than a failure of the core booking flow.

effort.reason: A sign-up on sold-out departures plus a notification on cancellation fits the existing booking and email flow.

unclustered.text: Could you add Japanese to the booking widget? We're seeing a lot more guests from Japan this season.
unclustered.reason: Feature request for Japanese language in the booking widget; no other operator asked for localisation.

disposition.label: Backlog · low priority
disposition.reason: Only one request so far – kept as a signal to watch; revisit if more operators ask.

unclustered.text: Our office laptop died and nobody remembers which email address the main account was registered with. Can you help us get back in?
unclustered.reason: One-off account recovery support case, not a product need.

disposition.label: Routed to support – not a product need

unclustered.text: Is there a way to export the emails of customers who agreed to marketing? We want to send a winter newsletter.
unclustered.reason: Marketing consent export for a newsletter; single request, unrelated to the other themes.
